content.title: Revalidate an inherited handover decision
content.purpose: Separate the historical finding from current admissibility
applicability: A resumed handover with a recorded owner-accepted version and an inherited blocker
preconditions: Archived outcome and accepted SHA can be checked

steps.instruction: For a resumed handover, compare the previous decision at its recorded basis with the owner's accepted revision. Where a historical blocker may be stale, verify it against current evidence bound to the accepted SHA. Preserve the old outcome and still-valid artifacts when revising the active decision.

checks: Current sources are pinned to the accepted revision
limitations: Unknown or unreadable source remains unresolved

admission.rationale: Scoped cold handover method grounded in the original refusal and a verified same-SHA replay.
